servesPizza.name: Bar Cotto
servesPizza.note: A Parma-style salumeria and cocktail bar from chef Ethan Stowell, built around charcuterie and bruschetta, that also serves 13-inch pizzas ($13-$16) alongside spaghetti and calzones.

servesPizza.name: Cora Pizza & Plates
servesPizza.note: An Italian restaurant from chef John Sundstrom with starters, pasta (rigatoni bolognese, spaghettini puttanesca), wood-roasted vegetables and dessert, whose 11-inch wood-fired pizzas include cheese, pepperoni, margherita, cacio e pepe, and mushroom pies.

servesPizza.name: Single Shot
servesPizza.note: A Capitol Hill bar and restaurant with a stone oven that turns out a Pizza Margherita ($12) and a Tuscan Kale flatbread alongside bites, cocktails and entrees like striped bass and pork chop.
